acceptanceCriteria: pre-compact emits a valid pin within the 2 s kill on a worktree with more than 700 dirty tracked paths in at least 99% of measured runs
the measurement is retained in a build-log entry
body:
Measured by the bugs-runtime lane (V1-1974, 2026-10-20). Every one of 67 not-preserved hours followed a pre-compact degradation, and all 39 pin-less summaries fall in degraded hours. V1-1974 now reports compaction-pin-not-emitted, but the underlying timeout remains on this repository (dirty set of about 700 tracked paths).
Expected: pre-compact emits a pin within its budget on large dirty worktrees, or degrades to a bounded pin.
